proof_groups.proof_strategy: For each witness, select the generated pure emp alternative. Unfold CircularAreaIsFullResult; for the three IsFull witnesses choose the directly forced result branch. For the two GetDataLength witnesses, destruct CircularAreaIsFullResult, use retval = 0 or retval <> 0 to eliminate the incompatible branch, unfold CircularAreaDataLengthResult, and select the remaining full/non-full branch. Finish structural conjunctions, reflexive result equalities, and 0/1 contradictions with standard propositional or lia-style arithmetic without forbidden lemmas.
proof_groups.grouping_reason: All five obligations share the same pure result-predicate classification pattern and need no helper family or dependency ordering; keeping them together minimizes worker count and remains below max_witnesses_per_group = 12.

space_plan.all_witnesses: Select the right pure entailment disjunct with emp. No spatial transformation is required; the left disjunct has identical complete CircularArea and UCharArray.full resources on both sides.

pure_plan.is_full_returns: Unfold CircularAreaIsFullResult and choose the branch directly established by readidx/writeidx and b_status guards.
pure_plan.data_length_returns: Unfold CircularAreaIsFullResult, eliminate the branch incompatible with retval = 0 or retval <> 0, then unfold CircularAreaDataLengthResult and choose the forced non-full or full branch.

witness_instantiation.all_witnesses: No existential witnesses; returned result terms are already explicit and match the selected result-predicate branches.
